Heritage 22 Mar 2025

Honoring Mayor SEVERO A. PALANCA: The Visionary Behind Victorias’ Cityhood & Mayor JAVIER MIGUEL L. BENITEZ: Continuing the Legacy of Service and Leading Victorias to the Pinnacle of Success

As we celebrate the 27th Kadalag-an Festival, we take a moment to honor and remember the man whose leadership and determination transformed Victorias from a small, quiet town into the thriving, progressive city it is today, Mayor Severo Acuña Palanca.

It was under his tireless leadership that Victorias was officially recognized as a component city of Negros Occidental through Republic Act No. 8488, signed into law by President Fidel V. Ramos on February 11, 1998. The law was ratified by an overwhelming majority in a plebiscite held on March 21, 1998, a date we now commemorate annually as Charter Day.

THE JOURNEY TO CITYHOOD

The path to cityhood was not an easy one. It required persistence, strategic lobbying, and strong alliances with national leaders. We extend our gratitude to those who supported this cause, including:

Congressman Kako Lacson – A key legislative sponsor of the cityhood bill.

Senator Aquilino Pimentel – A staunch advocate for local governance and cityhood conversions.

Senator Tito Sotto – who was a co-sponsor of the Senate version of the bill on the cityhood of Victorias

President Fidel V. Ramos – Who signed R.A. No. 8488 into law, making Victorias a city.House

Speaker Jose de Venecia – wjo approved House Bill 10290

Senator Ernesto Maceda – who served as Senate President from October 10, 1996, to January 26, 1998 during the 10th

Congress.Congressman Felix Alfelor – One of the lawmakers instrumental in pushing for Victorias’ cityhood.

Governor Rafael Coscolluela, Vice Governor Roy Gamboa – Leaders who ensured provincial support for the transition.

Vice Mayor Eduardo Villaruz – Who worked alongside Mayor Palanca in leading Victorias toward progress.

Mr. Rodolfo Tribaco – for his expertise in budget and finance and for his technical support

Dr. Ernesto A. Palanca – who helped lobby for his senator friends, Tito Sotto and Sergio Osmeña.

Atty. Simplicio A. Palanca – Who generously funded travel and lobbying efforts to make cityhood a reality.

As the Sangguniang Kabataan Federation President of Negros Occidental and a seating ex-officio member of the Provincial Board, I personally delivered to the Senate the SK resolution seeking support for the cityhood of Victorias.The incumbent Councilors, Punong Barangays and their Kagawads, Department Heads, Municipal Employees, Civic Organizations, schools and all who supported the Cityhood of Victorias.

On the historic day of February 11, 1998, Mayor Severo A. Palanca and the officials of Victorias proudly witnessed the signing of the law at Malacañang Palace. The final step came when the people of Victorias overwhelmingly voted YES in the plebiscite on March 21, 1998, sealing the town’s transformation into a city.

KADALAG-AN FESTIVAL: A CELEBRATION OF TRIUMPH

The Kadalag-an Festival, first celebrated on March 21, 1999, is a tribute to this historic achievement. More than just a festival, it embodies the resilience, unity, and aspirations of the people of Victorias. Every year, we celebrate not just the city’s legal recognition but the spirit of triumph over challenges—a legacy that Mayor Palanca left behind.

CONTINUING THE LEGACY: MAYOR JAVIER MIGUEL L. BENITEZ

Today, as we move forward, we express our deep appreciation to Mayor Javier Lopez Benitez , who continues to steer Victorias to greater heights. His dynamic leadership builds upon Mayor Palanca’s foundation, ensuring that Victorias remains a model city of progress, innovation, and good governance.Under his administration, Victorias is embracing digital transformation, sustainable urban development, and a more inclusive approach to governance. His unwavering dedication to economic growth, technological advancements, and cultural preservation reflects the same visionary leadership that once guided the city to its historic cityhood.

As we celebrate 27 years of cityhood, let us not forget to honor the man who made it possible, while also recognizing the leader who now carries the torch towards a brighter and more prosperous future. Let us offer our heartfelt gratitude and prayers for the peaceful repose of Mayor Severo A. Palanca, while also giving our full support to Mayor Javi Benitez, who leads Victorias toward the pinnacle of success.

Padayon, Victorias City!

Happy 27th Kadalag-an Festival!

To God be all the Glory!

March 21, 2025, 6:45am, Victorias City
